quotes: maintenance is the work champions do between the work.
your body keeps score. pay attention.
the athlete who doesn't break down wins.
recovery is not weakness. neglect is.
ten minutes of this beats ten months of physio.
the best injury is the one that never happens.
you maintain a car. maintain the machine that drives it.
longevity is a training goal too.
move well before you move heavy.
your joints will thank you. eventually.
boring is what keeps you in the game.
elite athletes do this. now so do you.
fix the small things before they become big ones.

stations.name: World's Greatest Stretch
stations.description: Deep lunge, both hands inside front foot. Rotate one arm up toward ceiling, eyes follow hand. Return and repeat.

stations.name: Chin Tucks
stations.description: Pull head straight back making a double chin. Hold 2 seconds, release. Keep eyes level, don't tilt.

stations.name: Single-Leg Stance
stations.description: Stand on one foot, hips level. Find a fixed point to stare at. Don't let the hip drop. Switch sides.

stations.name: Pogo Hops
stations.description: Small fast hops off both feet. Minimal ground contact. Knees mostly straight. Land on balls of feet.

stations.name: Split Squats
stations.description: Staggered stance, lower back knee toward floor. Drive through front heel to stand. Complete all reps each side.

stations.name: Scapular Pull-Ups
stations.description: Hang from a bar. Shrug shoulders up toward ears then pull them down without bending elbows. Control each rep.

stations.name: Single-Leg RDL
stations.description: Stand on one leg, slight knee bend. Hinge at hips reaching toward floor, back flat. Drive hips forward to stand. Each side.

stations.name: Wall Angels
stations.description: Back flat against wall, arms in W shape. Slide arms up to Y and back down. Keep back and arms touching wall.

stations.name: Clamshells
stations.description: Lie on side, knees bent, hips stacked. Open top knee like a clamshell without rotating your hips. Slow and controlled.

stations.name: Open Books
stations.description: Lie on side, knees stacked. Rotate top arm across body opening toward the floor behind you. Follow with eyes.

stations.name: Tibialis Raises
stations.description: Lean against wall, heels about a foot out. Lift toes and forefoot up toward shins. Lower slow. Feel the shin burn.

stations.name: Neck Isometrics
stations.description: Press palm against forehead, side, then back of head. Push hard against your hand without letting head move. 10s each direction.

stations.name: Dead Bugs
stations.description: On back, arms up, knees at 90. Extend opposite arm and leg out slowly. Lower back stays flat. Bring back and switch.

stations.name: Glute Bridges
stations.description: Knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips to ceiling squeezing glutes hard. Pause at the top. Lower with control.

stations.name: Wall Sit
stations.description: Back flat on wall, slide down until thighs are parallel to floor. Knees at 90. Hold. Breathe steadily.

stations.name: Dead Hang
stations.description: Hang from bar, arms fully extended, shoulders relaxed and packed. Breathe. Let the spine decompress.
